title: Database Schema Extension for AI Services
description: Extend the existing database schema to support AI service functionality including user API keys, chat sessions, usage analytics, and secure key storage
details: Using Drizzle ORM, create new tables: `user_api_keys` (with encrypted API keys for different providers), `chat_sessions` (to track chat conversations), `chat_messages` (individual messages with metadata), and `usage_analytics` (to log AI service usage with tokens, costs, timestamps). Implement encryption utilities for API key storage using AES encryption. Create and run database migrations to add these tables to the existing PostgreSQL database. Ensure proper foreign key relationships with the existing users table.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for encryption/decryption utilities. Create integration tests for database operations including CRUD operations on new tables. Test migration scripts in a separate database instance to ensure they run without conflicts.
ai_result: Created comprehensive database schema for AI services including user_api_keys, chat_sessions, chat_messages, usage_analytics, image_generations, and web_scrapes tables with proper relationships, encryption support, and indexes. Also created encryption utilities and migration SQL file.

title: API Key Management System
description: Implement secure API key management functionality allowing users to store, view, and manage their third-party AI service API keys
details: Create `/dashboard/settings/keys` page with forms for adding API keys for different providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). Implement server actions for securely storing encrypted keys in the database. Build UI components using shadcn/ui for key management including add/edit/delete operations. Implement validation using Zod schemas for API key formats. Add middleware to decrypt and retrieve keys for authenticated API calls. Include fallback to system-provided keys when user keys are not available.
test_strategy: Test encryption/decryption of API keys. Verify that keys are never exposed in client-side code. Test form validation and error handling for invalid keys. Mock external API calls to verify key retrieval works correctly.
ai_result: Implemented complete API key management system including server actions for CRUD operations, secure encryption/decryption utilities, API key format validation, and a full-featured UI page with add/edit/delete functionality. Updated sidebar navigation to include AI features and API Keys page.

title: AI Chat Interface with Multi-Model Support
description: Build an interactive chat interface supporting multiple AI models with streaming responses, customizable system prompts, and chat history
details: Create `/dashboard/chat` page with chat UI using Vercel AI SDK's `useChat` hook. Implement server action at `/api/chat` that handles model selection, retrieves user API keys, sends requests to AI providers, and streams responses back. Build components for message display, model selection dropdown, system prompt customization, and chat history. Implement proper error handling for API failures and rate limits. Log all interactions to usage_analytics table with token counts and model information.
test_strategy: Mock AI provider APIs for testing. Test streaming functionality with different message types. Verify chat history persistence and retrieval. Test error handling for invalid API keys and rate limits. Ensure proper logging of usage metrics.
ai_result: Built comprehensive AI chat interface with multi-model support including streaming responses using Vercel AI SDK, session management, real-time message history, customizable system prompts, and model selection across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google providers. Implemented proper error handling, usage analytics logging, token counting, and cost calculation.

title: Image Generation and Web Scraping Modules
description: Implement image generation functionality and web scraping capabilities using Firecrawl API
details: Create `/dashboard/image-generation` page with form for image prompts, style selection, and generated image display. Implement `/api/image` server action for calling image generation APIs. Create `/dashboard/web-scraper` page with URL input form and structured data display. Implement `/api/scrape` server action integrating with Firecrawl API. Both modules should use the API key management system, log usage to analytics, and provide proper error handling. Include image storage/display functionality and structured data visualization for scraping results.
test_strategy: Mock external APIs (image generation and Firecrawl). Test form validation and submission. Verify proper error handling for invalid URLs or failed API calls. Test image display and data visualization components. Ensure usage logging works correctly for both services.
ai_result: Implemented image generation functionality with support for OpenAI DALL-E and Stability AI, including advanced settings, multiple sizes and styles, cost tracking, and download capabilities. Built web scraping module using Firecrawl API with format selection, content extraction, metadata parsing, and comprehensive result display with markdown and raw data views.

title: Analytics Dashboard with Usage Visualization
description: Transform the existing dashboard into a comprehensive analytics interface showing AI service usage metrics, charts, and detailed breakdowns
details: Enhance `/dashboard/page.tsx` to fetch and display usage analytics from the database. Create interactive charts using existing chart components to show usage over time, model distribution, token consumption, and cost analysis. Implement data tables for detailed usage logs with filtering and sorting capabilities. Add summary cards showing total usage, favorite models, and spending trends. Create server actions to aggregate analytics data efficiently. Include real-time updates and proper loading states.
test_strategy: Test data aggregation queries for performance with large datasets. Verify chart rendering with different data scenarios. Test filtering and sorting functionality. Mock analytics data for consistent testing. Ensure proper loading states and error handling for data fetching failures.
ai_result: Created comprehensive analytics dashboard with real-time usage visualization including summary cards showing total requests, costs, and sessions; interactive charts displaying usage over time and provider distribution; detailed model usage tables; recent activity feeds; and period filtering with 7/30/90 day views. Implemented analytics API with aggregation queries for efficient data processing.
